sections.title: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list

rows.label: Personal income tax (daň z príjmov fyzických osôb) [national]
rows.value: 19% of the tax base up to 154.8× the subsistence minimum (EUR 43,983.32 in 2026), 25% up to 212.4×, 30% up to 264× and 35% above; personal allowance EUR 5,966.73. Paid by residents on worldwide income, non-residents on Slovak-source income. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 11 and 15.
rows.note: Checklist item A1; detailed table: income-tax

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), §§ 11 and 15

rows.label: Capital gains of individuals (taxed as income) [national]
rows.value: Gains on property are exempt after 5 years of ownership; gains on securities and other assets are taxed as income; small other income up to EUR 500 a year is exempt. Paid by individuals selling assets. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 8 and 9.
rows.note: Checklist item A5

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), § 9

rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties (daň vyberaná zrážkou) [national]
rows.value: 7% on dividends paid to individuals; 19% on deposit interest and on interest and royalties paid to non-residents; 13% on government bond yields; 35% on payments to non-cooperating states. Paid by the recipient (withheld by the payer). Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. § 43.
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: investment-income

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), § 43

rows.label: Rental income and pension income [national]
rows.value: Rental income is taxed on the scale after actual expenses or 60% flat expenses (at most EUR 20,000); pensions are reflected in the personal allowance rules (§ 11 (6)). Paid by landlords and pensioners. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 6 and 11.
rows.note: Checklist item A7

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), § 6 ods. 10 and § 6 ods. 4

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (daňovník s obmedzenou daňovou povinnosťou) [national]
rows.value: Pay for work done in Slovakia is taxed on the normal 19% to 35% scale with monthly advances withheld by the employer; the personal allowance is given, the spouse allowance and child bonus only with at least 90% of income from Slovak sources; residence test: permanent residence, home or 183 days. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 2, 11, 15, 16 and 33.
rows.note: Checklist item A8; detailed table: non-resident

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), §§ 2, 11 and 16

rows.label: Social insurance contributions (sociálne poistenie) and health insurance [national]
rows.value: Employee 9.4% (sickness 1.4%, old-age 4%, disability 3%, unemployment 1%) and employer 25.2% social insurance up to the 11× average wage ceiling; health insurance employee 5%, employer 11% (2026). Paid by employees and employers. Zákon č. 461/2003 Z. z. §§ 130 to 137; zákon č. 580/2004 Z. z..
rows.note: Checklist item B1; detailed table: social-employee

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 461/2003 Z. z. o sociálnom poistení (Social Insurance Act), version in force 1 September to 30 December 2026, § 130 to § 137

rows.label: Employer levies: disability employment quota levy (odvod za neplnenie povinného podielu) [national]
rows.value: Employers with at least 20 employees must employ 3.2% people with disabilities; for each missing person the levy is 0.9× the total labour cost on the average wage. Paid by employers with at least 20 employees. Zákon č. 5/2004 Z. z. §§ 63 and 65.
rows.note: Checklist item B2; detailed table: employer-levies

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 5/2004 Z. z. o službách zamestnanosti, version in force from 1 August 2026, §§ 63 and 65

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (SZČO): social and health insurance [national]
rows.value: Social insurance on an assessment base from the tax base, minimum base EUR 914.40 a month in 2026 (minimum EUR 303.11); health insurance at least 16% of the minimum base (EUR 121.92 a month); no compulsory social insurance below the income test. Paid by self-employed persons (SZČO). Zákon č. 461/2003 Z. z.; zákon č. 580/2004 Z. z..
rows.note: Checklist item B3; detailed table: szco-contributions

source.title: Ministerstvo práce, sociálnych vecí a rodiny SR: Zmeny od 1. júla 2026

rows.label: Contractor rules: the dependent-work test and withholding on payments to contractors [national]
rows.value: Dependent work may not be done under a civil or commercial contract; doing it without an employment relationship is illegal work; 19% withholding on fees for creating works and artistic performances; 19% security withholding on payments to non-EU/EEA non-resident contractors (35% non-cooperating states). Paid by clients and contractors. Zákon č. 311/2001 Z. z. § 1; zákon č. 82/2005 Z. z. § 2; zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 43 and 44.
rows.note: Checklist item B3b; detailed table: contractor-rules

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 311/2001 Z. z. Zákonník práce, version in force from 1 September 2026, § 1

rows.label: Corporate income tax (daň z príjmov právnických osôb) [national]
rows.value: 10% for revenue up to EUR 100,000, 21% standard, 24% for revenue above EUR 5 million; minimum tax EUR 340 to EUR 11,520 by revenue; 15% global minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least EUR 750 million. Paid by companies and other legal persons. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 15 and 46b; zákon č. 507/2023 Z. z..
rows.note: Checklist item C1; detailed table: corporate-tax

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), §§ 15 and 46b

rows.label: Local business taxes: vending machine tax and non-gambling gaming machine tax [municipal]
rows.value: Set by each municipality in euros per machine and calendar year. Paid by operators of the machines. Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. §§ 2 (1) (e) and (f), 47 and 55.
rows.note: Checklist item C2

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. o miestnych daniach ..., version in force from 1 September 2026

rows.label: Simplified regime for the self-employed: flat-rate expenses and the 15% rate [national]
rows.value: Flat-rate expenses of 60% of income (at most EUR 20,000 a year) for non-VAT payers; 15% income tax on the business tax base where taxable revenue is at most EUR 100,000. Paid by self-employed persons who opt for flat-rate expenses. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 6 (10) and 15 (a) (2).
rows.note: Checklist item C3; detailed table: self-employed-tax

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), §§ 6 and 15

rows.label: Tax on distributed profits and branch profits [national]
rows.value: 7% withholding on dividends paid to individuals (35% for non-cooperating states); branches pay the corporate rates on the profit of the Slovak permanent establishment. Paid by shareholders (withheld by the paying company); foreign companies with a Slovak branch. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 16 and 43.
rows.note: Checklist item C4; detailed table: distributed-profits

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), § 43

rows.label: Value added tax (daň z pridanej hodnoty, DPH) [national]
rows.value: 23% standard, 19% and 5% reduced rates. Paid by consumers (charged by VAT payers). Zákon č. 222/2004 Z. z. § 27.
rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: vat

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 222/2004 Z. z. o dani z pridanej hodnoty (VAT Act), version in force 1 January to 31 December 2026, § 27

rows.label: Excise duties (spotrebné dane) [national]
rows.value: Petrol EUR 514 and diesel EUR 368 per 1,000 litres; spirits EUR 1,490.40 per hl of alcohol; still wine nil; cigarettes 25% of the price plus EUR 91.30 per 1,000 (at least EUR 148). Paid by producers and importers (passed on in prices). Zákony č. 98/2004, 530/2011 and 106/2004 Z. z..
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 98/2004 Z. z. o spotrebnej dani z minerálneho oleja, version in force from 1 January 2026, § 6

rows.label: Insurance premium tax (daň z poistenia) [national]
rows.value: 10% of the premium for non-life insurance listed in annex 1 (from insurance periods starting after 31 December 2025). Paid by insurers. Zákon č. 213/2018 Z. z. §§ 8 and 13a.
rows.note: Checklist item D4

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 213/2018 Z. z. o dani z poistenia, version in force from 1 January 2026, §§ 8 and 13a

rows.label: Financial transaction tax (daň z finančných transakcií) [national]
rows.value: 0.4% of each non-cash transaction (at most EUR 40), 0.8% of cash withdrawals and EUR 2 per payment card. Paid by legal persons making financial transactions (collected through their payment service provider). Zákon č. 279/2024 Z. z. §§ 3 and 6.
rows.note: Checklist item D4

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 279/2024 Z. z. o dani z finančných transakcií, version in force from 1 January 2026, §§ 3 and 6

rows.label: Excise duty on electricity, coal and natural gas (energy tax) [national]
rows.value: Electricity EUR 1.32 per MWh; natural gas EUR 1.32 per MWh (EUR 9.36 as motor fuel); coal EUR 10.62 per tonne. Paid by suppliers (passed on to final consumers). Zákon č. 609/2007 Z. z. §§ 6, 18 and 30.
rows.note: Checklist item D5; detailed table: excise

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 609/2007 Z. z. o spotrebnej dani z elektriny, uhlia a zemného plynu, version in force from 1 January 2026

rows.label: Property tax (daň z nehnuteľností) [municipal]
rows.value: Statutory rates: land 0.25% of the land value, buildings and flats EUR 0.033 per m²; each municipality raises or lowers them by ordinance. Paid by owners of land, buildings and flats. Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. §§ 8, 12 and 16.
rows.note: Checklist item E1; detailed table: property-tax

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. o miestnych daniach a miestnom poplatku za komunálne odpady a drobné stavebné odpady, version in force from 1 September 2026

rows.label: Property transfer: land register fee (správny poplatok za vklad) [national]
rows.value: EUR 100 per application to register a right in the cadastre (EUR 50 filed electronically); sellers' gains are exempt from income tax after 5 years. Paid by the applicant (usually the buyer). Zákon č. 145/1995 Z. z., tariff item 11; zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. § 9.
rows.note: Checklist item E2; detailed table: property-transfer

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 145/1995 Z. z. o správnych poplatkoch, version in force from 1 November 2026, tariff item 11

rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax: inheritances and gifts outside income tax [national]
rows.value: Inheritances and gifts (other than gifts connected with the recipient's business or employment activity) are not subject to income tax. Paid by no one (business gifts: the recipient's income tax). Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. § 3 (2) (a).
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), § 3 ods. 2

rows.label: Motor vehicle tax (daň z motorových vozidiel) and registration fee [national]
rows.value: Annual tax only on vehicles registered in Slovakia and used for business: cars by engine size, e.g. EUR 62 (150 to 900 cm³) to EUR 148 (1,500 to 2,000 cm³), electric cars nil; first registration of a car EUR 33 to 900 by engine power × an ecological coefficient. Paid by businesses using vehicles; vehicle registrants. Zákon č. 361/2014 Z. z. §§ 2, 3 and annex 1; zákon č. 145/1995 Z. z., tariff item 65.
rows.note: Checklist item F1

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 361/2014 Z. z. o dani z motorových vozidiel, version in force from 1 January 2025, §§ 2, 3 and annex 1

rows.label: Accommodation tax (daň za ubytovanie) [municipal]
rows.value: Set by each municipality in euros per person and night. Paid by guests (collected by the accommodation provider). Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. §§ 2 and 40.
rows.note: Checklist item F3

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. o miestnych daniach ..., version in force from 1 September 2026, §§ 2 and 40

rows.label: Customs duty, import VAT and travel allowances [EU and national]
rows.value: EU Common Customs Tariff on the customs value; the EUR 150 duty relief ended on 1 July 2026 (EUR 3 per item for IOSS and postal consignments until 1 July 2028); import VAT at 23% / 19% / 5%; travellers EUR 300 (land) or EUR 430 (air and sea); 40 cigarettes by land, 200 by air; cash of EUR 10,000 or more must be declared. Paid by importers and travellers. Regulation (EU) 2026/382; Directive 2007/74/EC; Regulation (EU) 2018/1672.
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs

source.title: EUR-Lex: Council Regulation (EU) 2026/382 of 11 February 2026

rows.value: Fixed fees per official act in the tariff of the Act, for example EUR 100 for a land register application (EUR 50 online) and EUR 33 to 900 for first registration of a car. Paid by people and businesses requesting the act. Zákon č. 145/1995 Z. z. (tariff items 11 and 65).
rows.note: Checklist item H1

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 145/1995 Z. z. o správnych poplatkoch, version in force from 1 November 2026

rows.label: Municipal waste fee (miestny poplatok za komunálne odpady) [municipal]
rows.value: Set by each municipality: a flat EUR 0.02 to 0.2 per person and day (or the yearly equivalent), or a volume-based rate. Paid by residents and property owners. Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. § 78.
rows.note: Checklist item H2

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. o miestnych daniach ..., version in force from 1 September 2026, § 78

rows.value: None since 1 July 2023: Act No. 340/2012 on the public service fee is no longer in force (its last version applied until 30 June 2023). Paid by no one. Zákon č. 340/2012 Z. z. (repealed).
rows.note: Checklist item H2

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 340/2012 Z. z. o úhrade za služby verejnosti poskytované Rozhlasom a televíziou Slovenska, version in force from 1 July 2021 to 30 June 2023

rows.label: Expat and new residents: no inbound regime or digital-nomad permit [national]
rows.value: No reduced rate or exemption for new residents: residents (permanent residence, home or 183 days) pay the normal rates on worldwide income; no digital-nomad residence purpose (see the freelancers section). Paid by new residents. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. § 2; zákon č. 404/2011 Z. z. § 21.
rows.note: Checklist item H3; detailed table: freelancers

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), § 2 písm. d) and § 15

rows.label: Surcharge on income tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: no surcharge on income tax is among the tax acts administered under the Tax Procedure Code; the personal income tax rates are those of the Income Tax Act. Paid by no one. Zákon č. 563/2009 Z. z., § 2 písm. b) and footnote 1.
rows.note: Checklist item A2

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 563/2009 Z. z. o správe daní (daňový poriadok), version in force 1 September to 31 December 2026, § 2 písm. b) and footnote 1

rows.value: None: the local taxes a municipality may levy are the property tax, dog tax, public space tax, accommodation tax, vending machine tax, non-gambling gaming machine tax, tax on vehicles entering a historic town centre and nuclear facility tax, plus the municipal waste fee. rows.note: Checklist item A3

source.title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. o miestnych daniach a miestnom poplatku za komunálne odpady a drobné stavebné odpady, version in force 1 September to 31 December 2026, § 2

rows.note: Checklist item A4

rows.value: Compulsory contributions of 4% of the assessment base in 2024 and later years; participation starts automatically with the first pension insurance of a person under 40. Paid by employers for participating employees; participating self-employed and voluntarily insured persons; the Social Insurance Agency in some cases. Zákon č. 43/2004 Z. z. o starobnom dôchodkovom sporení, §§ 15, 21 and 22.
rows.note: Checklist item B4

rows.note: Checklist item E3

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A1; detailed table: income-tax
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), §§ 11 and 15
rows.label: Personal income tax (daň z príjmov fyzických osôb) [national]
rows.value: 19% of the tax base up to 154.8× the subsistence minimum (EUR 43,983.32 in 2026), 25% up to 212.4×, 30% up to 264× and 35% above; personal allowance EUR 5,966.73. Paid by residents on worldwide income, non-residents on Slovak-source income. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 11 and 15.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A5
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), § 9
rows.label: Capital gains of individuals (taxed as income) [national]
rows.value: Gains on property are exempt after 5 years of ownership; gains on securities and other assets are taxed as income; small other income up to EUR 500 a year is exempt. Paid by individuals selling assets. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 8 and 9.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: investment-income
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), § 43
rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties (daň vyberaná zrážkou) [national]
rows.value: 7% on dividends paid to individuals; 19% on deposit interest and on interest and royalties paid to non-residents; 13% on government bond yields; 35% on payments to non-cooperating states. Paid by the recipient (withheld by the payer). Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. § 43.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A7
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), § 6 ods. 10 and § 6 ods. 4
rows.label: Rental income and pension income [national]
rows.value: Rental income is taxed on the scale after actual expenses or 60% flat expenses (at most EUR 20,000); pensions are reflected in the personal allowance rules (§ 11 (6)). Paid by landlords and pensioners. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 6 and 11.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A8; detailed table: non-resident
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), §§ 2, 11 and 16
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (daňovník s obmedzenou daňovou povinnosťou) [national]
rows.value: Pay for work done in Slovakia is taxed on the normal 19% to 35% scale with monthly advances withheld by the employer; the personal allowance is given, the spouse allowance and child bonus only with at least 90% of income from Slovak sources; residence test: permanent residence, home or 183 days. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 2, 11, 15, 16 and 33.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item B1; detailed table: social-employee
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 461/2003 Z. z. o sociálnom poistení (Social Insurance Act), version in force 1 September to 30 December 2026, § 130 to § 137
rows.label: Social insurance contributions (sociálne poistenie) and health insurance [national]
rows.value: Employee 9.4% (sickness 1.4%, old-age 4%, disability 3%, unemployment 1%) and employer 25.2% social insurance up to the 11× average wage ceiling; health insurance employee 5%, employer 11% (2026). Paid by employees and employers. Zákon č. 461/2003 Z. z. §§ 130 to 137; zákon č. 580/2004 Z. z..

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item B2; detailed table: employer-levies
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 5/2004 Z. z. o službách zamestnanosti, version in force from 1 August 2026, §§ 63 and 65
rows.label: Employer levies: disability employment quota levy (odvod za neplnenie povinného podielu) [national]
rows.value: Employers with at least 20 employees must employ 3.2% people with disabilities; for each missing person the levy is 0.9× the total labour cost on the average wage. Paid by employers with at least 20 employees. Zákon č. 5/2004 Z. z. §§ 63 and 65.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item B3; detailed table: szco-contributions
rows.source_title: Ministerstvo práce, sociálnych vecí a rodiny SR: Zmeny od 1. júla 2026
rows.label: Self-employed contributions (SZČO): social and health insurance [national]
rows.value: Social insurance on an assessment base from the tax base, minimum base EUR 914.40 a month in 2026 (minimum EUR 303.11); health insurance at least 16% of the minimum base (EUR 121.92 a month); no compulsory social insurance below the income test. Paid by self-employed persons (SZČO). Zákon č. 461/2003 Z. z.; zákon č. 580/2004 Z. z..

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item B3b; detailed table: contractor-rules
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 311/2001 Z. z. Zákonník práce, version in force from 1 September 2026, § 1
rows.label: Contractor rules: the dependent-work test and withholding on payments to contractors [national]
rows.value: Dependent work may not be done under a civil or commercial contract; doing it without an employment relationship is illegal work; 19% withholding on fees for creating works and artistic performances; 19% security withholding on payments to non-EU/EEA non-resident contractors (35% non-cooperating states). Paid by clients and contractors. Zákon č. 311/2001 Z. z. § 1; zákon č. 82/2005 Z. z. § 2; zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 43 and 44.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item C1; detailed table: corporate-tax
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), §§ 15 and 46b
rows.label: Corporate income tax (daň z príjmov právnických osôb) [national]
rows.value: 10% for revenue up to EUR 100,000, 21% standard, 24% for revenue above EUR 5 million; minimum tax EUR 340 to EUR 11,520 by revenue; 15% global minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least EUR 750 million. Paid by companies and other legal persons. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 15 and 46b; zákon č. 507/2023 Z. z..

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item C2
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. o miestnych daniach ..., version in force from 1 September 2026
rows.label: Local business taxes: vending machine tax and non-gambling gaming machine tax [municipal]
rows.value: Set by each municipality in euros per machine and calendar year. Paid by operators of the machines. Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. §§ 2 (1) (e) and (f), 47 and 55.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item C3; detailed table: self-employed-tax
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), §§ 6 and 15
rows.label: Simplified regime for the self-employed: flat-rate expenses and the 15% rate [national]
rows.value: Flat-rate expenses of 60% of income (at most EUR 20,000 a year) for non-VAT payers; 15% income tax on the business tax base where taxable revenue is at most EUR 100,000. Paid by self-employed persons who opt for flat-rate expenses. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 6 (10) and 15 (a) (2).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item C4; detailed table: distributed-profits
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), § 43
rows.label: Tax on distributed profits and branch profits [national]
rows.value: 7% withholding on dividends paid to individuals (35% for non-cooperating states); branches pay the corporate rates on the profit of the Slovak permanent establishment. Paid by shareholders (withheld by the paying company); foreign companies with a Slovak branch. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. §§ 16 and 43.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: vat
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 222/2004 Z. z. o dani z pridanej hodnoty (VAT Act), version in force 1 January to 31 December 2026, § 27
rows.label: Value added tax (daň z pridanej hodnoty, DPH) [national]
rows.value: 23% standard, 19% and 5% reduced rates. Paid by consumers (charged by VAT payers). Zákon č. 222/2004 Z. z. § 27.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 98/2004 Z. z. o spotrebnej dani z minerálneho oleja, version in force from 1 January 2026, § 6
rows.label: Excise duties (spotrebné dane) [national]
rows.value: Petrol EUR 514 and diesel EUR 368 per 1,000 litres; spirits EUR 1,490.40 per hl of alcohol; still wine nil; cigarettes 25% of the price plus EUR 91.30 per 1,000 (at least EUR 148). Paid by producers and importers (passed on in prices). Zákony č. 98/2004, 530/2011 and 106/2004 Z. z..

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item D4
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 213/2018 Z. z. o dani z poistenia, version in force from 1 January 2026, §§ 8 and 13a
rows.label: Insurance premium tax (daň z poistenia) [national]
rows.value: 10% of the premium for non-life insurance listed in annex 1 (from insurance periods starting after 31 December 2025). Paid by insurers. Zákon č. 213/2018 Z. z. §§ 8 and 13a.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item D4
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 279/2024 Z. z. o dani z finančných transakcií, version in force from 1 January 2026, §§ 3 and 6
rows.label: Financial transaction tax (daň z finančných transakcií) [national]
rows.value: 0.4% of each non-cash transaction (at most EUR 40), 0.8% of cash withdrawals and EUR 2 per payment card. Paid by legal persons making financial transactions (collected through their payment service provider). Zákon č. 279/2024 Z. z. §§ 3 and 6.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item D5; detailed table: excise
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 609/2007 Z. z. o spotrebnej dani z elektriny, uhlia a zemného plynu, version in force from 1 January 2026
rows.label: Excise duty on electricity, coal and natural gas (energy tax) [national]
rows.value: Electricity EUR 1.32 per MWh; natural gas EUR 1.32 per MWh (EUR 9.36 as motor fuel); coal EUR 10.62 per tonne. Paid by suppliers (passed on to final consumers). Zákon č. 609/2007 Z. z. §§ 6, 18 and 30.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item E1; detailed table: property-tax
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. o miestnych daniach a miestnom poplatku za komunálne odpady a drobné stavebné odpady, version in force from 1 September 2026
rows.label: Property tax (daň z nehnuteľností) [municipal]
rows.value: Statutory rates: land 0.25% of the land value, buildings and flats EUR 0.033 per m²; each municipality raises or lowers them by ordinance. Paid by owners of land, buildings and flats. Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. §§ 8, 12 and 16.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item E2; detailed table: property-transfer
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 145/1995 Z. z. o správnych poplatkoch, version in force from 1 November 2026, tariff item 11
rows.label: Property transfer: land register fee (správny poplatok za vklad) [national]
rows.value: EUR 100 per application to register a right in the cadastre (EUR 50 filed electronically); sellers' gains are exempt from income tax after 5 years. Paid by the applicant (usually the buyer). Zákon č. 145/1995 Z. z., tariff item 11; zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. § 9.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), § 3 ods. 2
rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax: inheritances and gifts outside income tax [national]
rows.value: Inheritances and gifts (other than gifts connected with the recipient's business or employment activity) are not subject to income tax. Paid by no one (business gifts: the recipient's income tax). Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. § 3 (2) (a).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item F1
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 361/2014 Z. z. o dani z motorových vozidiel, version in force from 1 January 2025, §§ 2, 3 and annex 1
rows.label: Motor vehicle tax (daň z motorových vozidiel) and registration fee [national]
rows.value: Annual tax only on vehicles registered in Slovakia and used for business: cars by engine size, e.g. EUR 62 (150 to 900 cm³) to EUR 148 (1,500 to 2,000 cm³), electric cars nil; first registration of a car EUR 33 to 900 by engine power × an ecological coefficient. Paid by businesses using vehicles; vehicle registrants. Zákon č. 361/2014 Z. z. §§ 2, 3 and annex 1; zákon č. 145/1995 Z. z., tariff item 65.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item F3
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. o miestnych daniach ..., version in force from 1 September 2026, §§ 2 and 40
rows.label: Accommodation tax (daň za ubytovanie) [municipal]
rows.value: Set by each municipality in euros per person and night. Paid by guests (collected by the accommodation provider). Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. §§ 2 and 40.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs
rows.source_title: EUR-Lex: Council Regulation (EU) 2026/382 of 11 February 2026
rows.label: Customs duty, import VAT and travel allowances [EU and national]
rows.value: EU Common Customs Tariff on the customs value; the EUR 150 duty relief ended on 1 July 2026 (EUR 3 per item for IOSS and postal consignments until 1 July 2028); import VAT at 23% / 19% / 5%; travellers EUR 300 (land) or EUR 430 (air and sea); 40 cigarettes by land, 200 by air; cash of EUR 10,000 or more must be declared. Paid by importers and travellers. Regulation (EU) 2026/382; Directive 2007/74/EC; Regulation (EU) 2018/1672.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item H1
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 145/1995 Z. z. o správnych poplatkoch, version in force from 1 November 2026
rows.label: Administrative fees (správne poplatky) [national]
rows.value: Fixed fees per official act in the tariff of the Act, for example EUR 100 for a land register application (EUR 50 online) and EUR 33 to 900 for first registration of a car. Paid by people and businesses requesting the act. Zákon č. 145/1995 Z. z. (tariff items 11 and 65).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item H2
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. o miestnych daniach ..., version in force from 1 September 2026, § 78
rows.label: Municipal waste fee (miestny poplatok za komunálne odpady) [municipal]
rows.value: Set by each municipality: a flat EUR 0.02 to 0.2 per person and day (or the yearly equivalent), or a volume-based rate. Paid by residents and property owners. Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. § 78.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item H2
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 340/2012 Z. z. o úhrade za služby verejnosti poskytované Rozhlasom a televíziou Slovenska, version in force from 1 July 2021 to 30 June 2023
rows.label: Broadcasting licence fee (úhrada za služby verejnosti) [national]
rows.value: None since 1 July 2023: Act No. 340/2012 on the public service fee is no longer in force (its last version applied until 30 June 2023). Paid by no one. Zákon č. 340/2012 Z. z. (repealed).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item H3; detailed table: freelancers
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. o dani z príjmov (version in force 1 January to 30 December 2026), § 2 písm. d) and § 15
rows.label: Expat and new residents: no inbound regime or digital-nomad permit [national]
rows.value: No reduced rate or exemption for new residents: residents (permanent residence, home or 183 days) pay the normal rates on worldwide income; no digital-nomad residence purpose (see the freelancers section). Paid by new residents. Zákon č. 595/2003 Z. z. § 2; zákon č. 404/2011 Z. z. § 21.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A2
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 563/2009 Z. z. o správe daní (daňový poriadok), version in force 1 September to 31 December 2026, § 2 písm. b) and footnote 1
rows.label: Surcharge on income tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: no surcharge on income tax is among the tax acts administered under the Tax Procedure Code; the personal income tax rates are those of the Income Tax Act. Paid by no one. Zákon č. 563/2009 Z. z., § 2 písm. b) and footnote 1.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A3
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. o miestnych daniach a miestnom poplatku za komunálne odpady a drobné stavebné odpady, version in force 1 September to 31 December 2026, § 2
rows.label: Regional or municipal income tax: none [municipal]
rows.value: None: the local taxes a municipality may levy are the property tax, dog tax, public space tax, accommodation tax, vending machine tax, non-gambling gaming machine tax, tax on vehicles entering a historic town centre and nuclear facility tax, plus the municipal waste fee. Paid by no one. Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z., § 2.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A4
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 370/2019 Z. z. o finančnej podpore činnosti cirkví a náboženských spoločností, version in force from 1 January 2025, §§ 1 to 3
rows.label: Church tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: churches receive an annual state contribution from the Ministry of Culture budget and earmarked grants. Paid by no one. Zákon č. 370/2019 Z. z., §§ 1 to 3.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item B4
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 43/2004 Z. z. o starobnom dôchodkovom sporení, version in force 1 August 2026 to 31 December 2027, §§ 15, 21, 21a and 22
rows.label: Funded old-age pension savings with auto-enrolment (starobné dôchodkové sporenie) [national]
rows.value: Compulsory contributions of 4% of the assessment base in 2024 and later years; participation starts automatically with the first pension insurance of a person under 40. Paid by employers for participating employees; participating self-employed and voluntarily insured persons; the Social Insurance Agency in some cases. Zákon č. 43/2004 Z. z. o starobnom dôchodkovom sporení, §§ 15, 21 and 22.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item D2
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. o miestnych daniach a miestnom poplatku za komunálne odpady a drobné stavebné odpady, version in force 1 September to 31 December 2026, § 2
rows.label: Regional or municipal sales tax: none [municipal]
rows.value: None: no sales or consumption tax is among the local taxes a municipality may levy; VAT is a national tax. Paid by no one. Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z., § 2.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item E3
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 563/2009 Z. z. o správe daní (daňový poriadok), version in force 1 September to 31 December 2026, § 2 písm. b) and footnote 1
rows.label: Wealth tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: no net wealth tax is among the tax acts administered under the Tax Procedure Code. Paid by no one. Zákon č. 563/2009 Z. z., § 2 písm. b) and footnote 1.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item F2
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 190/2023 Z. z. o poplatkoch za znečisťovanie ovzdušia, version in force from 1 January 2025, §§ 1 and 2 and annex 2
rows.label: Environmental charge: air pollution fee (poplatok za znečisťovanie ovzdušia) [national and municipal]
rows.value: Base fee per tonne emitted by large and medium sources: particulate matter EUR 330, SO2 EUR 130, NOx EUR 100, CO EUR 60, ammonia EUR 60, total organic carbon EUR 260, times a compensation coefficient (1.2 for 2026 emissions); fees on small sources only where a municipality introduces them. Paid by operators of stationary sources of air pollution. Zákon č. 190/2023 Z. z. o poplatkoch za znečisťovanie ovzdušia, §§ 1 to 3 and annex 2.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Slovakia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item F4
rows.source_title: Slov-Lex: Zákon č. 563/2009 Z. z. o správe daní (daňový poriadok), version in force 1 September to 31 December 2026, § 2 písm. b) and footnote 1
rows.label: Departure or air passenger tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: no departure or air passenger tax is among the tax acts administered under the Tax Procedure Code. Paid by no one. Zákon č. 563/2009 Z. z., § 2 písm. b) and footnote 1.
